title: Ari's reply blocks
description: A reply is Markdown. Where its content has a shape, Ari writes it as a fenced block whose info string is `ari:` and a kind, holding one JSON object, and the app draws it natively. A block the app doesn't recognise, or whose JSON doesn't parse, shows as its fenced text. Blocks are never spoken on a call. A block's part is its 0-based index among the reply's `ari:` blocks, of every kind.

Plan.title: ari:plan
Plan.description: Something to do step by step, with items you can tick: an itinerary, a to-do list, a packing list, a training week. Ticks go to the server, which keeps them on the message as `ticks`; the block's own `done` is how Ari wrote it.

id.description: Unique within the plan, such as `book-flights`.

when.description: When it happens, in plain words, such as "Fri 6 Nov, morning".

Place.title: ari:place
Place.description: A place you might go. The app opens it in Maps.

Time.title: ari:time
Time.description: A time worth keeping. The app adds it to your calendar or reminders on the phone, with no approval from the server.

start.description: Local date and time, such as `2026-11-06T08:15`, or a date, such as `2026-11-06`, for all day.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Rome`.

Compare.title: ari:compare
Compare.description: Options side by side, with the same facts for each, and Ari's pick.

facts.description: The same keys for every option, in the order to show them.

pick.description: The name of the option Ari would choose.

Choices.title: ari:choices
Choices.description: Short answers you might give next, to tap. A tap sends the label as an ordinary message; unlike an ask, nothing waits for it.

Motion.title: ari:motion
Motion.description: A compact line under a reply when Ari starts or changes a thing in motion, such as "Florence trip: booked the Uffizi". Tapping it opens the thing. Draw the line from the `MotionChange` with that version, or from the thing's title when there's none.

change.description: The thing's version the line is about.

Images.title: ari:images
Images.description: Pictures Ari found on the web, kept on the server as attachments so the app never contacts their hosts. Never generated.

source_url.description: The page the picture came from.

credit.description: Who made it, as its source asks.
